body:
`main` fails the privacy gate at `18d73783`, and so does every branch based on it. The gate exempts exactly one squash commit, `ae982af`. Every later pull request is squash-merged on GitHub, so its commit carries the account's noreply author and GitHub as committer, and the gate refuses it.

- `scripts/check_privacy.py` accepts exactly that identity pair, still with a one-line message, beside the holder identity. The `ae982af` exception is unchanged. Content scanning is unchanged.
- `check_privacy.py --selftest` checks the rule with six identity controls: both accepted pairs pass, mixed or foreign pairs fail. `validate.py` runs it.
- [IMPORT.md](docs/IMPORT.md) and [VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md) describe the rule.

Validation: all 24 `validate.py` gates pass with GoogleTest 1.14.0 and Clang 18. The bare-metal job is unaffected (scripts and docs only).

Blocks tsn-c-stack #14: its branch fails the privacy gate only because of this.

title: Accept the GitHub squash identity in the privacy gate
